The most striking visual feature of the remaining structure is the series of stone dragons carved along the main staircase.

These dragons, crafted in the 15th century, are masterpieces of architectural art, showcasing the exquisite craftsmanship of the early Lê Dynasty. Each dragon is carved from green stone, featuring elongated, sinuous bodies with raised heads, round, protruding eyes, long, branching horns, and detailed manes that curve backward.
